title: Masha and the Bear bake a cake.
lines: Deep in the forest there's a little house.
A big brown bear lives there.
He's calm and he likes peace and quiet.
And he looks after his vegetable garden.
But a little girl lives close by.
She wears a pink headscarf and she's never quiet.
She runs, she jumps, she asks a thousand questions.
One morning Masha knocks on the bear's door.
It isn't your birthday, but we're going to bake a cake anyway!
He can never say no to Masha.
The bear takes out a big cookbook.
And eggs, sugar, butter and milk.
Masha takes the bag of flour.
One egg falls on the floor.
One egg falls on the bear's head.
Masha stirs so fast that the batter flies around the kitchen.
The bear pours what's left into a tin.
He puts the cake in the oven.
Now we wait, says the bear.
After a while it smells delicious.
Masha decorates the cake with berries from the garden.
She makes a little face with them.
The bear looks at the cake.
He looks at the messy kitchen.
And then he smiles after all.
When Masha goes home, she gives the bear a hug.
The bear sinks into his chair.
But really he's glad to have a little friend like her.
